brief: DAD.LOG per-entry attachment for NOTICE_07.SCN (dadlog-archive-reader ui-spec, section F, ROUND 3 addendum). A single clinical FINAL NOTICE letterhead form, flat-on view like a scanned document: a formal printed form with a boxed header block, several boxed data fields down the sheet (account/balance/status style rows implied by shape only), an official-looking stamp or seal mark in one corner, and a signature-style scrawl near the bottom. Every field's contents rendered as ILLEGIBLE printed-line texture (short flat rules and blocky marks standing in for text, never actual readable characters or numerals - the dither must crush it to texture). 1990s anime OVA ink style, flat cel shading, crisp high-contrast linework so the form's boxes and stamp read clearly after 1-bit dithering. Absolutely NO readable text, NO panel borders (beyond the form's own diegetic boxed fields, which are not comic-panel borders), NO speech bubbles anywhere; background a plain flat dark surface, nothing else in frame.
